products.title: Atomic Driver
products.body_html:
The Atomic Driver is built for golfers who want to hit it farther without feeling like they need a tour-level swing to control it.

Stable, forgiving and easy to trust, it’s built to deliver faster ball speeds, lower spin and more consistent shot patterns, with 10 yards more distance on center hits and an average of 8 yards more total distance.

Designed to deliver:
Faster Ball Speeds for more distance off the tee
Lower Spin for a stronger flight and more roll
Efficient Energy Return for more consistent speed from swing to swing
Predictable Dispersion for tighter, more repeatable shot patterns
More Forgiveness for better results on less-than-perfect contact

All backed by a 60-day money-back guarantee.

Due to high demand, shipping can take 1-3 business days.

Hot-Forged Titanium Face
Delivers faster ball speeds and strong energy transfer, even when you miss the center of the face. Translation: more pop, more distance and a bigger sweet spot.

Carbon Crown
Launches the ball higher, carrying farther and staying more forgiving on off-center hits. How? By replacing a traditional metal crown with lightweight carbon fiber, which saves weight and moves the CG (ie: center of gravity) lower in the club head.

Reduced Spin
Stronger ball flight with less ballooning and more roll after landing, created by our lighter carbon crown that moves weight lower in the club head.

Adjustable Weight System
Uses one heavier weight and two lighter balance weights to fine-tune your ball flight. Move the heavier 9g weight to the heel for draw bias, the toe for fade bias, or the center for maximum forgiveness.

Adjustable Hosel
Lets you make simple setup tweaks to better match your swing, by fine-tuning how the ball launches. Start at the balanced 10.5° setting, adjust loft +/- 1° to help raise or lower ball flight, or use the draw-bias setting to help reduce a slice.

Upgraded Shaft
Reduces big misses while keeping the driver smooth and easy to swing. The shaft flex was tuned to add stability through the swing, so the club head feels more controlled at impact without feeling overly stiff.
